levers.name: Deterministic quality polish
levers.benefit: Choose Fine or Perfect quality; consumes Star Thread and burns YARN.
levers.risk: Tradable power: cap progression benefit and retain free bound route.

levers.name: Seasonal cafe decor
levers.benefit: Permanent backdrop/pedestal unlock for Star Thread and YARN; no random reward.
levers.risk: Low power risk; avoid forced collection or paid Bell rewards.

levers.name: Collection archive pages
levers.benefit: Spend Stars and a small YARN fee for a named lore page, badge and trophy.
levers.risk: Cosmetic utility must be desirable; demand uncertain, do not assume all buy.

levers.name: Guaranteed masterwork enhancement
levers.benefit: Deterministic +8..+10 alternative consuming Stars; no transferable payment for a roll.
levers.risk: Power purchase risk; bound earned Stars and daily limits, test no YARN-to-random route.

levers.name: Deed display expansion
levers.benefit: More cosmetic display slots; burns YARN and consumes Star Thread.
levers.risk: Do not increase yields or require it for ordinary play.

levers.name: Named seasonal relic craft
levers.benefit: Fixed named non-power relic with Star Thread recipe and disclosed YARN burn.
levers.risk: Supply must be issuer-reserved and finite; no mystery output.

levers.name: Bound material refinement
levers.benefit: Deterministic Star Thread to useful bound crafting materials with weekly conversion cap.
levers.risk: Must not convert transferable assets into Bells or another random-payment route.

levers.name: Daily tower progression budget
levers.benefit: Activity-sensitive daily floor budget separates calendar progression from unlimited hours.
levers.risk: Time gates may feel arbitrary; casual catch-up credit and visible limits.

levers.name: Diminishing daily Spool by verified activity
levers.benefit: Front-load legitimate sessions, taper repeated identical rewards and limit bot-hour advantage.
levers.risk: Avoid declaring accounts bots by fiat; model observable flags, false positives and evasion.

levers.name: Deterministic set focus
levers.benefit: Choose a fixed same-tier set conversion for Stars; player sees exact output.
levers.risk: No affix reroll or random outcome paid by YARN/Stars.
